sourceDecision: Retain production. SortIcon imports ArrowUpDown/ArrowUp/ArrowDown from lucide-react. Its declared inactive branch returns ArrowUpDown with className="w-3 h-3 text-zinc-600"; its active dir === "asc" branch selects ArrowUp, otherwise ArrowDown, both with className="w-3 h-3 text-indigo-400". Each literal icon call supplies only className: no explicit aria-hidden, aria-label, aria-labelledby, role, focusable, tabIndex or title prop, and no JSX spread is declared there. This is a call-site declaration observation, not a statement about lucide implementation/defaults, rendered SVG attributes, decorative semantics, computed accessible names, color contrast, focus, keyboard, announcements or actual AT. SortHeader constructs SortIcon with exact active/dir props, defaults iconFirst=false, and places label then icon in that default source branch; iconFirst reverses their declared order. The existing native-button aria-label names the column and current direction when active; no label/click/sort change is made. The saved metadata-announcements and metadata-success declaration selections omit MetadataTable/SortHeader/SortIcon, substituting a props-only table or string placeholder. Their selected role/aria-live assertions concern synthetic table props only. No icon, callback, hook, render or test is invoked. No concrete supported correction compatible with frozen expectations was established.
